subject: Security intake: SIG vs custom questionnaire + SOC 2 / HIPAA clarifying asks (Northstar Health)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Martin <alicia.martin@northstarhealth.com>
Cc: security@northstarhealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Security intake: SIG vs custom questionnaire + clarifying questions

Hi Alicia — great chat this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary from call:
- Use case: internal triage + clinician-facing summarization (no PHI stored long-term, some flow-through of PHI during inference).
- Hosting: northstar confirmed they want US-only residency (us-east-1).
- Compliance: HIPAA in-scope; will need a BAA. SOC 2 Type II is in progress (you mentioned an audit window in Q2).

Questions / asks for you (can you confirm these in reply?):
1) Preferred questionnaire format — SIG (standardized) or a custom CAIQ-style mapping? You mentioned procurement prefers a mapped CAIQ; security leaned toward SIG. Which should we prepare first?
2) SOC 2 timing — can you share approximate date range or expected report availability? Helps us map evidence.
3) Data deletion / retention — do you require a documented deletion API / SLA?
4) Any hosting subnets or connectivity constraints (VPC peering, private link) we should know about?

Proposed next steps:
- If SIG is preferred we can send a prefilled SIG-lite within 3 business days and Rishi can follow up on evidence items. (I’ve attached a short overview of how our SIG/CAIQ prefill works.)
- If CAIQ mapping is required, we’ll prep a CAIQ CSV and call out any gaps against SOC 2.
- Draft BAA and basic SOW language to be looped in once procurement is engaged.

Attachments: redwood-sig-overview.pdf (overview + sample prefill)

Would love a quick reply with the preferred questionnaire and any firm SOC 2 target date. We’ll hold on the BAA draft until procurement confirms contacts.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Martin <alicia.martin@northstarhealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@northstarhealth.com, procurement@northstarhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security intake: SIG vs custom questionnaire + clarifying questions

Hi Tessa — thanks for the recap and for the overview doc. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Preferred questionnaire: procurement would like a CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) so they can drop it into our vendor portal; security is fine with SIG if you can include a CAIQ export. So, could you do a SIG prefill + CAIQ export? That would cover both teams.
- SOC 2: We are in the tail end of the Type II audit window. Expect final SOC 2 Type II report by mid-April 2026 (tentative). We can share an audit readiness note earlier if needed.
- HIPAA / BAA: HIPAA is in-scope. We will need a signed BAA before any production traffic. Please route legal/procurement communications to procurement@northstarhealth.com.
- Data residency: Yes, all data must remain in us-east-1. We also require an ability to request account-wide deletion of customer data (API or documented process) with a 30-day SLA for deletions.
- Encryption: we'd like confirmation of encryption at rest (KMS, customer-managed KMS if available). Can you include encryption details in the CAIQ prefill? I’ve attached our simplified dataflow diagram so you can see the flows we’re thinking about.

Procurement note: please share any standard SOW/BAA templates and an initial quote estimate to procurement@northstarhealth.com.

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Martin | Senior Security Manager, Northstar Health
Attachment: northstar-dataflow-diagram.png

- Rishi Malhotra (cc’d) will take lead on the CAIQ mapping, SOC 2 evidence requests, and encryption/KMS details.
- Jordan Blake (cc’d) will coordinate procurement asks, BAA draft, and quote/SOW routing.

A few quick confirmations we’ll plan against unless you tell us otherwise:
- SOC 2 Type II final report target = mid-April 2026 (we’ll request interim evidence now).
- Data residency = us-east-1 only; Redwood will document data deletion workflow and provide the API/process and target SLA (we can commit to providing documented deletion within the 30-day window; engineering will confirm exact timings).
- Encryption: we will include KMS key management and whether customer-managed KMS is available in the prefill.

If that all looks correct, we’ll send the SIG + CAIQ export on Thu and Rishi will follow up with a sheet of requested evidence and links to the docs we need (SOC 2 in-scope systems, control owners, encryption proof).

Best — Tessa
